evidence_items.explanation: The preceding sentence gives end-2023 U.S.–China gaps of 17.5, 13.5, 24.3 and 31.6 percentage points on MMLU, MMMU, MATH and HumanEval. All four narrowed by end-2024, including the language, mathematics and coding measures directly relevant to this claim.

The contemporaneous report corroborates that a leading Chinese model had approached leading closed-model performance before the post. It is developer-reported evidence and is secondary in weight to the cross-country benchmark comparison.
